newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE says will take proper steps against Nomura Securities.
newsitem.headline: TSE says will take proper steps against Nomura Securities.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Tuesday that it will take proper steps if needed against Nomura Securities Co Ltd, now involved in a scandal over illicit transactions.
TSE president Mitsuhide Yamaguchi told a news conference that it would be "regrettable" if Japan's securities watchdog were to find that the brokerage was involved in illegal transactions.

"When it (the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission) unveils the outcome of its investigation, we would like to take necessary and appropriate steps," Yamaguchi said, when asked whether the TSE is considering taking any punitive measures against the scandal-tainted brokerage. Yamaguchi did not elaborate.

Nomura said on March 6 that two of its directors, who have since resigned, had made discretionary transactions with a corporate client and transferred profits from its own account to the client's account.
